interfaces.contract: Versioned QGT/topological model evidence bound to exact source revisions. Great Scale's model exports Richardson-style empirical estimates, not a rigorous error certificate; G6 requires a separate independently verified interval-enclosure or analytic-derivative-bound certificate with source/input binding and certified error upper bounds within tolerance. The residual libraries are not live production measurement endpoints.
Validated intent and an independently evaluated capability decision.
Resource/method-bound capability and stable operation identity.
Observed execution receipt, status, and lineage.
Receipt provenance and authority state returned to the admission layer.

mapping.measurementBuildIdDistinctFromTargetBuil: measurementBuildId identifies the Great Scale measurement build; targetBuildId identifies the Control Plane acceptance build. These are independent identities and must not be assumed equal.
mapping.targetBuildIdToResidualBuildId: targetBuildId must equal final G0-G6 attestation.buildId and becomes residual.buildId.
mapping.targetSourceRevisionToAttestationSource: target.repository/commitSha must equal final G0-G6 attestation.source.repository/commitSha.
mapping.targetArtifactDigestToAcceptanceArtifact: targetArtifact.digest must equal final G0-G6 attestation.artifact.digest.
mapping.measurementArtifactBinding: artifact.digest identifies the Great Scale model/measurement artifact and model.inputDigest binds its inputs; verify independently and never substitute it for targetArtifact.digest.
mapping.trustBoundary: verify Ed25519 against an independently configured public key; receipt cannot choose its trust anchor
mapping.numericalCertificationRequired: A separate numericalCertification object is mandatory; errorBoundMethod labels Richardson estimates as empirical only and never as rigorous proof.
mapping.numericalCertificationEvidenceVerified: Independently fetch and validate numericalCertification.evidenceUrl; recompute proofDigest; pin verifierId and method; require sourceCommitSha=source.commitSha, modelInputDigest=model.inputDigest, and both certified upper bounds <= measurement.quadratureTolerance.
mapping.numericalCertificationClaimNotProof: numericalCertification.verified=true is only a claim; independently verify proof evidence and trust policy before G6 promotion.
mapping.numericalCertificationTrustAnchorSeparat: certificateKeyId and certificateSignature must verify under a separately configured, independently pinned numerical-certificate public key; do not treat the outer G6 receipt signature as proof of the certificate.
